fifthCollapse.sectionDesc1: Customer Satisfaction Score (CSAT) is a widely used metric that helps service providers gauge how satisfied customers are with various aspects of their experience, such as purchasing, shipping, and more
fifthCollapse.sectionDesc2: With Zid Logistics, you can easily measure how satisfied your customers are with their shipping experience. When a shipment is delivered through Zid Logistics, a brief questionnaire is automatically sent via SMS to the customer's mobile phone in the following format:
fifthCollapse.sectionDesc3: Customer responses are automatically categorized into three groups: satisfied customers are those who rate the service a 4 or 5, neutral customers give a rating of 3, and dissatisfied customers rate it a 1 or 2. To calculate the customer satisfaction rate, divide the number of satisfied responses by the total number of responses and multiply by 100. For example, if 10 customers responded to the questionnaire and 5 of them were satisfied, the satisfaction rate would be (5 ÷ 10) × 100 = 50%.
fifthCollapse.sectionDesc4: A customer satisfaction rate of 70% or higher is generally considered excellent. It's important to note that the number of customers who complete the survey can impact how accurately you assess overall satisfaction. On average, only about 15% of customers respond to such surveys. For example, if you send the questionnaire to 100 customers, you can expect around 15 responses, based on the typical global response rate of 15%. This is widely accepted as a good and reliable benchmark.

firstCollapse.sectionDesc1: It is a technical solution for managing shipping companies based on shipping methods, offering access to over 15 carriers through a single digital contract—all activated with just one click.
firstCollapse.sectionDesc2: Zid Logistics does not charge any service fees. However, to transfer orders to "Ready," you must top up your balance in advance via electronic payment or bank transfer. This prepaid amount is used to cover the cost of your shipments (shipping labels) through Zid Logistics.
firstCollapse.sectionDesc3: Zid Logistics can be activated in your online store to offer shipping and delivery services to your customers through multiple carriers under a single digital contract. It provides various shipping options, competitive rates, and the ability to customize pricing with the support of a dedicated team.
firstCollapse.sectionTitle2: Does the Zid Logistics service have any fees?
firstCollapse.sectionTitle3: What is the difference between activating Zid Logistics and activating any other shipping company?
firstCollapse.title: About Zid Logistics

fourthCollapse.sectionDesc1List1: - online payment: when choosing online payment, the amount must be a multiple of fifty (50), noting that the maximum charge limit is 1,000,000. the balance will be charged immediately, and you will start using Zid Logistics, and your orders will be changed to ready status to start shipping
fourthCollapse.sectionDesc1List2: - bank transfer: when you choose to pay via bank transfer, the minimum amount for shipment is SAR 50,000. The transfer will be accepted within 48 working hours. After accepting it, you can start using Zid Logistics and change the order to ready status to start shipping.
fourthCollapse.sectionDesc1List3: When your balance is about to expire, you will receive an e-mail to notify you of this, but even when the balance is depleted, the Zid Logistics option will still appear to your customers in the store as an available delivery option.
fourthCollapse.sectionDesc1List4: In the event that you do not want to compete with the Zid Logistics team, you can refund the amount that you paid in advance and which is in your current balance.
fourthCollapse.sectionDesc2: You can follow all prepaid shipments through the service collection window and shipments that have been deducted from your prepaid balance. Every sunday of every week, you will receive in the mail a weekly invoice for the amounts deducted from your balance for the delivery of your completed and returned shipments.
fourthCollapse.sectionDesc3: While the payment service for cash on delivery has been activated, the payment amounts will be collected upon delivery by Zid Logistics and within two working weeks, the amounts will be transferred.
fourthCollapse.sectionTitle1: What prepaid payment options are available with Zid Logistics?
fourthCollapse.sectionTitle2: How do i follow up on advance payment-related operations?
fourthCollapse.sectionTitle3: How is the money collected for shipments of cash on delivery amounts?
fourthCollapse.title: Payments settlement in Zid Logistics

secondCollapse.sectionDesc1: Choosing the right level depends on:
secondCollapse.sectionDesc1List1: 1 - The type and weight of your products to choose the appropriate shipping type for you (for example: refrigerated shipping for food and the like)
secondCollapse.sectionDesc1List3: 3 - The right price for you and your customers
secondCollapse.sectionDesc1List4: 4 - Your preferred delivery method and the most suitable for your store (e.g., the shipping company picks up shipments from your warehouse, or you deliver them yourself to the shipping company branch).
secondCollapse.sectionDesc2List1: - you can activate additional shipping methods at any time by clicking the "Activate Shipping Method" button
secondCollapse.sectionDesc2List2: - you can cancel any shipping method at any time by pressing the cancel button, but you must ensure that all shipments assigned to this method are delivered before canceling it
secondCollapse.sectionDesc3List1: When you activate the Zid Logistics service, you can customize shipping method prices to fit your preferences by clicking on "Customize." You can also define and limit city coverage for each shipping method to match your specific needs.
secondCollapse.sectionDesc3List2: For example, if a shipping method supports delivery to all cities in Saudi Arabia, but you choose to limit it to specific cities like Jeddah, Dammam, and Abha, then this shipping method will only be shown to customers in those selected cities

aramexGcc.term_1: The maximum weight: 35 kg, and the dimensions: 351 × 430 × 500 mm.
aramexGcc.term_10: Dues that will be deducted from the wallet when shipping to Qatar: If the shipment amount is between $1 and $272, a 20 Qatari riyal customs declaration fee and a $2 customs clearance fee will be charged and deducted from the wallet. If the shipment amount is more than $272, a 5% service fees and a 20 riyal customs clearance fee will be charged and deducted from the wallet. Qatari customs declaration fees, $5.5 customs clearance fees.
aramexGcc.term_11: Dues that will be deducted from the wallet when shipping to Oman: If the shipment amount is between $1 and $259, the following fees will be charged and deducted from the wallet: 5% state tax, 1 Omani riyal customs declaration fee, and $2.6 customs clearance fee. If the shipment amount is between $259 and $777, the following fees will be charged and deducted from the wallet: 5% state tax, 5% service fees, 1 Omani riyal customs declaration fee, and $4 customs clearance fee. If the shipment amount is more than $777, the following fees will be charged and deducted from the wallet: 5% state tax, 5% service fees, 15 Omani riyal customs declaration fee, and $4 customs clearance fee.
aramexGcc.term_2: Zid Logistics calculates the excess weight when the shipment arrives at the Zid Logistics warehouse or the last mile shipping company's warehouse, and accordingly the weight and shipment cost are updated and the wallet will be debited accordingly.
aramexGcc.term_3: The volume weight is calculated by calculating the dimensions of the shipment as follows: the volume weight: is the actual weight of the shipment by taking the dimensions (length x width x height)
aramexGcc.term_4: Regarding shipping companies and dealing with it, shipping companies always take the higher weight. Example: A shipment with an actual weight of 10 kg and a volumetric weight of 1 kg, the actual weight is taken. A shipment with an actual weight of 1 kg and a volumetric weight of 10 kg, the volumetric weight is taken. The method for calculating the dimensional volumetric weight is: (length x width x height) / 4000 (for domestic shipments) and (length x width x height) / 5000 (for international shipments). The weight subject to fees is the volumetric weight or the total weight, whichever is higher.
aramexGcc.term_5: In case of any notes (objection) regarding the invoice issued to the merchant, the merchant can object within (5) days from the date of issuance of the invoice.
aramexGcc.term_6: The merchant has no right to object after the expiry of the period specified in the above clause, and the invoice is considered due and payable.
aramexGcc.term_7: Dues that will be deducted from the wallet when shipping to the country: Kuwait: If the shipment amount is between $1 and $330, fees will be charged and deducted from the wallet, namely: 1 Kuwaiti Dinar customs declaration fee, $5 customs clearance fee. If the shipment amount exceeds $330, fees will be charged and deducted from the wallet, namely: 5% service fees, 1 Kuwaiti Dinar customs declaration fee, $10 customs clearance fee.
aramexGcc.term_8: Dues that will be deducted from the wallet when shipping to the country of Bahrain: If the shipment amount is between $1 and $770, no fees will be charged on the shipment. If the shipment amount exceeds $770, fees will be charged and deducted from the wallet, namely: 10% state tax, 5% service fees, and 5 Kuwaiti Dinars. Bahraini customs declaration fees, $8 customs clearance fees
aramexGcc.term_9: Dues that will be deducted from the wallet when shipping to the UAE: If the shipment amount is between $1 and $272, a 5% state tax will be charged and deducted from the wallet. If the shipment amount is more than $272, a 5% state tax, 5% service fees, AED 40 customs declaration fees, and $5.5 customs clearance fees will be charged and deducted from the wallet.
